scope: Independent source-mapping and observation-semantics review before empirical outcome computation. Mathematical ratio/contrast validation is delegated to a separate reviewer.

semantic_review.finding: Constructor marks the shared D+A frame as ambiguous without relying on graph issues. mass treats equality between death and cutoff as unknown before daughter traversal.
Death becomes absorbing at annotation+offset. The caller uses the same stricter annotation-at-or-before-baseline exclusion for both offsets.

The core baseline check uses actual offset death. This permits synthetic annotation0/offset1 first-interval deaths. The empirical caller separately enforces the frozen common eligibility rule; zero actual source baseline rows differ.
If death is strictly before the selected ambiguity cutoff, death is returned first and stays absorbing even when tracking continues. Equality is unknown.
Only ambiguity frames strictly greater than baseline enter the forward cutoff. Earlier component issues do not exclude the later recorded baseline cell.
For episodes with a postbaseline ambiguity, cutoff=max(episode first frame,baseline+1). This retains the time-zero snapshot and deliberately discards earlier within-episode observations.
Observed daughter vectors are summed and divided by2, and (2-observed daughters)/2 is added to unknown. No available-child renormalization occurs.
The parent snapshot is returned at baseline and at its division-annotation frame. Daughter traversal begins at division+1, which matches all observed edge boundaries.

The caller constructs one eligible roster per baseline outside offset/policy/horizon loops; it does not use future-completeness annotations to filter. Direct raw-source eligibility reconstruction matches every roster.
All common elapsed query and selection times convert to integer frames and remain inside source support for every baseline.

Known-live means recorded and not death-annotated under the frozen observation model. Fluorescence or a nonzero label is not independent biological proof of viability; disappearance without death remains unknown.

review_execution.gate_check_implementation: Inline review calculation; methods and aggregates recorded here, no standalone public checker claimed.

nonblocking_scope_limits: GraphMass constructor is not a complete validator for arbitrary replacement graphs: event-key exhaustiveness/unique episode mapping and issue-frame membership were checked independently for this pinned graph. New graphs require these gates or stricter constructor checks.
The caller pins the candidate graph and prior structural results, rather than reopening raw sources each run. This review additionally verified the original workbook and codebook hashes.
No certified original founder eligibility, replicate mapping, independent experiment count, or original exclusion-label namespace is recovered.
Observation error in labels or apoptosis annotations is not estimated by these intervals. The two timing offsets and ambiguity policies are fixed sensitivities, not validated biological clocks.
Rectangular ratio/contrast relaxations can contain incompatible complete-tree histories; passing this source review does not establish sharpness or a population hypothesis test.
